settings.title: Comfort & Warm Floors
settings.text: Warmup heats the whole room, from the floor up. This gives you the luxurious comfort of warm floors, and the benefit of a maintenance-free heating system. Because Warmup systems can be zoned room by room, everyone in the house can set their own levels of comfort, from the basement to the bedroom.

settings.title: Energy Efficiency & Low Running Costs
settings.text: Since electric floor heating systems use a lower temperature than standard forced-air systems or baseboards, heating costs are reduced. Because the heat source is spread throughout the floor, it is more evenly distributed and heated floors provide significantly higher levels of comfort. Electric floor heating systems have a low upfront installation cost and zero maintenance requirements. Why heat the entire house when everyone is in the kitchen? With a smart Warmup design, you can lower your furnace thermostat by as much as 3°F to 5°F.

settings.title: Design Freedom
settings.text: There are no heat vents, no ducts, no pipes, no mechanical room. Our systems give you complete freedom of design when remodeling and building your home. By zoning the Warmup systems in various parts of the house, you can select specific and accurate levels of comfort where and when you need it.
